The historical trn21 35c9 run was a different source and only a public-2M screen. The old trn21 r1 proposal and conditional Supervisor ratification bind the e65 stage_r2 checkout and are superseded as the planning/authority path for this r10 checkout; they do not ratify this proposal. The science label remains r1 because the frozen 22bfbab5 local and embedded-remote launcher validators reject any alternative trn21 label, including an invented r2 or r10 science label. No native attempt is recorded for that label in the local durable ledger; absence on the live host and in the native one-attempt ledger must be freshly proven before any launch.
trainium_feasibility: The dense 6x1024 c5c science graph, optimizer ownership, and model memory are unchanged. The intended command uses the full Trn2 chip with LNC=2 and four native ranks, pack factor 32, seed 42, 1800 training seconds, and optlevel=1 BF16 compiler flags. Six exact trn21 warm-cache paths are planned; no cold fallback or cleanup is proposed. The r10 trn21 launcher has independent source-only PASS, but the r10 checkout, live source identity, native request and binding chain, paired monitors, observer, compile, disk projection, and runtime remain unproved for this proposal.
cheapest_falsifier: Before any native attempt, reject if the r10 source stage is not independently accepted, the old e65 G2 cannot be independently rebound to the actual staged r10 bytes and values, the r1 science label or one-attempt marker is already consumed, a new final enabled native request or fresh dual-host preflight fails, or trn21 has less than 10737418240 free root bytes.
